signIn.title: Sign in

subtitle.owner: Console for building owners and managers

signIn.phoneHint: We will text you a 6-digit code
signIn.totpHint: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code
signIn.invitation: You are joining a tenant with an invitation

enrol.title: Set up two-step verification
enrol.body: Platform accounts need an authenticator app. Scan the QR code with the app (Google Authenticator, 1Password…) and enter the first 6-digit code.
enrol.qr: QR code for the authenticator app
enrol.secret: Or enter this secret in the app
enrol.secretWarning: The secret is shown once. Never share it.

tenantPicker.title: Choose a tenant
tenantPicker.body: Your account belongs to several tenants. Choose the one to work in now; you can switch any time from the top bar.

errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a 10-digit Thai mobile number, e.g. 0812345678

errors.otpExpired: The code has expired. Request a new one
errors.otpAttemptsExceeded: Too many wrong codes. Request a new one
errors.otpRateLimited: Too many codes requested. Wait a moment and try again
errors.accountLocked: The account is locked for a while after too many failed attempts
errors.accountDisabled: This account is disabled. Contact the owner or an administrator
errors.noAccess: This account has no access to this part yet
errors.totpInvalid: Wrong authenticator code. Use the latest one
